0.17.0: What's new, all of it: after an update she tells you what you missed since your version, not only the newest line. /mascot news lists it, and so does "What's new in every version" in /mascot settings.

0.17.0.text: She no longer stays stuck working after Claude publishes a page: its watch for comments is not work Claude is waiting on.

0.16.5: She rests while your screen is off or your PC is locked, and cursor magic waits until you are back.

0.16.4.text: She keeps working while Claude watches for something to finish, rather than going idle too early.

0.16.3: Smooth sparkles: her aura's sparkles can move as smoothly as her symbols. Off by default: turn it on in the Calm mode card or with /mascot smooth. Her sparkles are lighter to draw, too.
0.16.2: Smoother: her sparkles and auras step with her own motion, symbols move evenly, and soft edges and glows blend exactly. Much lighter while she works with warnings showing, and next to nothing while hidden.
0.16.1: She waits with Claude: a build, a test run or a monitor it is waiting on keeps her working, so happy and cursor magic come when it is really done.
0.16.0: Cursor magic: turn it on here, and a long job ends with her sending magic to your pointer.
Clicks pass through it, and it never takes the focus. Try it: /mascot magic.

0.15.1.text: She stays on top: when Windows lets a window slip above her, she is back in front within a second.

0.15.0: Updates: an Updates card here, /mascot update, and a banner for each new version.
Install from the marketplace: /plugin marketplace add desuqcafe/cc-mascot.
